dedupe_keys.name: wlc scenario explorer european building emissions

description: The WLC Scenario Explorer is a web application for viewing alternative whole-life-cycle greenhouse-gas paths for European buildings. It uses building life-cycle assessments and building-stock modelling from a European study to show effects of material choices, circularity, floor area and operational emissions. Users select a country, building type, strategy and scenario; outputs are charts and downloadable tables or images of modelled emissions. Geographic coverage is European countries represented by the study. Apache-2.0 source, deployment notes and a hosted application link are public. A limitation is that the displayed projections are scenario results tied to the study's stock and life-cycle assumptions, not measured future building emissions. The explorer can compare retrofit and construction strategies relevant to housing and energy infrastructure. The related catalogue EnergyPlus model simulates building energy use, not whole-life-cycle stock emissions. No study dataset, application package or screenshot was downloaded.
name: WLC Scenario Explorer European building emissions
notes: G7 G7-1590. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
